title: Current state of LLMs for Arabic dialectal machine translation
abstract: arXiv:2611.02271v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This work presents an evaluation of large language models (LLMs) for English to dialectal Arabic machine translation on the MADAR dataset. We evaluate both translation directions (English to Arabic and vice-versa) on 16 Arabic dialects. Our experiments cover a diverse set of models, including specialized Arabic models (Jais, Nile), multilingual models (Gemma, Command-R, Mistral, Aya), and commercial APIs (GPT-4.1). We employ multiple evaluation metrics: BLEU, CHRF, COMET (both reference-based and reference-less variants) and GEMBA (LLM-as-a-judge), as well as a small-scale manual evaluation, to assess translation quality. We discuss the challenges of automatic MT evaluation, especially in the context of Arabic dialects. We also evaluate the ability of LLMs to classify the dialect used in a text. translated_title: 大语言模型在阿拉伯语方言机器翻译中的现状
translated_abstract: 本工作对大型语言模型（LLM）在MADAR数据集上从英语到阿拉伯语方言的机器翻译能力进行了评估。我们在16种阿拉伯语方言上对两个翻译方向（英译阿及阿译英）进行了评估。实验涵盖了多样化的模型集合，包括专门的阿拉伯语模型（Jais、Nile）、多语言模型（Gemma、Command-R、Mistral、Aya）以及商业API（GPT-4.1）。我们采用多种评估指标：BLEU、CHRF、COMET（基于参考和无需参考的两种变体）以及GEMBA（以LLM作为评判者），并辅以小规模人工评估来衡量翻译质量。我们讨论了自动机器翻译评估面临的挑战，尤其是在阿拉伯语方言场景下的挑战。我们还评估了LLM对文本所用方言进行分类的能力。该研究深入揭示了当前LLM在阿拉伯语方言机器翻译方面的能力与局限，特别强调了……
tldr: 该研究在MADAR数据集上系统评估了包括阿拉伯语专用模型、多语言模型和商业API在内的多种大语言模型在英语与16种阿拉伯语方言之间双向机器翻译的表现，并探讨了方言机器翻译自动评估的挑战以及LLM的方言识别能力。
en_tdlr: This study systematically evaluates a diverse set of LLMs, including Arabic-specialized models, multilingual models, and commercial APIs, for bidirectional machine translation between English and 16 Arabic dialects on the MADAR dataset, while discussing the challenges of automatic MT evaluation for dialects and LLMs' dialect classification abilities.
